chunks: And my father (may Allah have mercy on him), and Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, and Ali ibn al-Husayn all narrated to me from Sa'd ibn 'Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Isḥaq ibn Ibrahim, from Harun, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Allah has dedicated to him four thousand angels, disheveled and covered with dust, [disheveled and covered with dust, who weep over him until the Day of Judgment.

key_terms.شُعْثٌ غُبْرٌ: Disheveled and covered with dust (describing the angels)

ai.seo_question: Who are the angels that weep over Imam Husayn (a.s.) according to Kamil al-Ziyarat?
ai.summary: In Kamil al-Ziyarat, Ibn Qulawayh records this tradition from Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.), emphasizing the cosmic scale of Imam al-Husayn’s (a.s.) martyrdom through the specific imagery of four thousand disheveled angels weeping until Qiyamah. This narration underscores the Shia belief that the Ahl al-Bayt’s suffering resonates throughout the celestial realms, validating their spiritual status and the eternal nature of their grief.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 7. My father, Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan, and ‘Ali ibn Ḥusain all narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from Ḥusain ibn Sa’īd, from Qāsim ibn Muḥammad, from Isḥāq ibn Ibrāhīm, from Hārūn (ibn Khārijah Al-Sayrafi), who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:
Allāh has dedicated four thousand angels who are disheveled and covered with dust to (the grave of) Ḥusain (a.s.) who cry over him (and will continue to do so) until the Day of Judgment.
